messages:
Anya: Heads-up: trying to finalize how console will detect "persistent v1 usage" vs transient bursts. proposal below. please flag missing signals.
Todd: high-level looks good. what's the exact detection window? 7d sliding? and do we use raw requests or token-weighted?
Anya: thinking 7d sliding for the primary signal, token-weighted. but we also want a 24h short window for spikes. two-tier approach: long-term share (7d token share) + short-term anomaly (24h delta).
Kareem: token-weighted is good for cost, but for customers who route short requests mostly, request-count matters for UX. i recommend emitting both and deciding UX rules on console.
Dina: Agree. UX suggestion: Banner shows long-term % (eg "v1 tokens: 28% over 7d"), modal breakdown shows both token% and request% with graphs. Also add a "likely cause" section based on detected signals: e.g., missing header, pinned SDK, proxy rewrite.
Anya: Good idea. How do we detect missing headers? we can check last-client-user-agent versions and presence/absence of version header. If mismatch between majority UA and header, flag header-strip.
Todd: Implementation: analytics side emits event `version_telemetry.v1_share` with dims: tenant, routeset, window(24h|7d), token_share, request_share, fallback_pct, sampling_rate. Also `version_telemetry.cause_hint` that can be set to enum: HEADER_STRIP, OLD_SDK, PROXY, OTHER.
Kareem: For sampling: compute exact metrics for tenants > 500rps; for others, run 1-in-10 sampling and extrapolate. Always include sampling_rate in event.
Dina: For console actions, we should provide quick links: open support ticket, enable migration-mode (enables auto-redirect to v2 for non-prod tokens), and view rollout checklist. Need copy for each.
Anya: About alerts: ops wants PagerDuty only for sustained fallback/error behaviors, not for headline banners. So banner = informational; PD if fallback_pct > 2% for 6h or error_rate > 1% for 1h. Sound right?
Todd: Fine. Also include an escalation path where SE can request a "soft-grace" that pauses banner for 14 days after confirming a migration plan in console. Track that as an audit event.
Kareem: Edge case: some tenants intentionally route to v1 for specific routes that are incompatible with v2. We need a per-tenant allowlist (route_exemptions) that prevents banner/alert for those routes. Console should show exemptions with owner and TTL.
Dina: UX: show exempted routes collapsed under "Acknowledged exceptions" and provide button "Request exemption" that creates a ticket with prefilled evidence.
infra-bot: FYI: schema migration `analytics.version_signals_v2` will add fields: cause_hint, sampling_rate, routeset_id. Rolling update targeted Fri 05:00 UTC. Creating feature branch.
Kareem: Metrics names to add: `redwood_v1_token_share`, `redwood_v1_request_share`, `redwood_v1_fallback_rate`. Also expose `redwood_v1_cause_hint` as label. We should avoid high cardinality labels on prod metrics; routeset_id ok in logs only.
Anya: Good point on cardinality. Use routeset_id in events but not as a Prom label; expose tenant_id and env as labels. For per-route troubleshooting, Grafana can join events from the analytics store.
Dina: For migration help, include an estimated cost delta row: current cost vs projected v2 cost with suggested settings (quantization, batching, response_trim). Kareem, can analytics supply rough % savings per tenant?
Kareem: I can build a lightweight estimator using sample requests and model cost profiles. it'll be approximate but useful. Add a flag `estimator_confidence` (low/medium/high) to show uncertainty.
Todd: One more: how to handle public SDKs that auto-upgrade header names? we should normalize both `X-Redwood-Version` and `Redwood-Version` in analyzer to avoid false positives.
Anya: Noted. Also, console copy: short banner + button "Analyze migration" that opens the modal. Banner text draft: "Your integration used v1 for 28% of tokens in the last 7 days. Analyze migration impact and steps." Keep CTA strong.
Dina: I'll make small mock and link to modal with three tabs: Overview, Causes, Migration Plan.
infra-bot: Deploy note: will enable feature flag `version_signals_v2` in staging next Tue. Prom rules PR #4111.
Anya: Action items: Kareem -> estimator prototype + events; Todd -> metrics and sampling ergonomics; Dina -> UX mock + modal copy; infra -> deploy plan & migration PR. We'll meet next Wed to review.
Dina: one-liner PRs posted pls so i can link from mock.
Kareem: Will post event schema in thread when ready.
Anya: Thanks all. If anyone thinks of additional cause signals (e.g., cache hit patterns, kv-cache TTL differences) ping here. Closing for now.
